# Template visual references

These are rendered examples retained as a visual guide. Match generated slides
to the actual layout name and placeholder geometry in `../layouts.json`.

| Image | Relevant real layout(s) | Visual cue |
|---|---|---|
| `examples/title-black.png`, `examples/title-yellow.png` | `Title - Black`, `Title - Yellow` | Display title and short subtitle |
| `examples/agenda.png` | `Agenda - Simple` | Large heading and short navigation list |
| `examples/big-statement.jpg` | `50/50 - big title`, `Statement title - image` | One large statement, with a real photo |
| `examples/statement-highlights.jpg` | `Statement - image + highlights` | Real photo with a few concise highlight captions |
| `examples/dual-image-statement.jpg` | `Statement - dual image` | Two real photos and brief captions |
| `examples/timeline-simple.png` | No generated timeline layout | Reference only; do not recreate it with custom shapes |
| `examples/end-slide-green.png`, `examples/end-slide-black.png` | `1_End slide - Green`, `End slide - Black bgr` | Minimal closing slide |
| `examples/brand-colors.png` | — | Brand palette reference |
| `examples/bad-example.png` | — | Avoid unbranded color, poor contrast, and clutter |

The source deck's editable sample slides are not present in the checked-in base
template. These images are references only; the generator cannot duplicate
their exact photo crops or composition. If the full brand deck is provided,
retain its sample slides while refreshing the template and use them as the
authoritative visual references.
